function.name: web_search
function.description: Fast web search across multiple search engines via Phrog Web (SearXNG + TinyFish fallback).

mode.description: Search mode: quick (default), live (news/recent), deep (multi-engine), academic (Consensus + arXiv)

function.name: academic_search
function.description: Search 220M+ peer-reviewed scientific papers via Consensus Academic API with study types, sample sizes, and plain takeaways.

function.name: github_search
function.description: Search public GitHub repositories for codebases, packages, stars, and licensing information.

function.name: deepwiki_ask
function.description: Query AI-generated codebase documentation for any public GitHub repository (deepwiki.com) with grounded inline citations.

question.description: Question about repository architecture, APIs, or internal logic

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Extract clean Markdown content from a URL via Phrog Web (cascading through Plain HTTP, Crawl4AI headless, and TinyFish).

url.description: Target URL to fetch and convert to Markdown

mode.description: Strategy: plain (fast), browser (Crawl4AI), or auto (smart fallback)

function.name: web_research
function.description: Synthesize research. Quick mode returns in ~4s (Vane). Deep workflows (lit, deepresearch, compare, audit, review, draft, recipe) dispatch autonomous Feynman agent in background.

domain.description: Domain target: web, academic (peer-reviewed papers), discussions

workflow.description: quick (Vane 4s synthesis) or Feynman workflow (lit: literature review, compare: cross-paper matrix, audit: code vs paper)

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL to receive deep research results when complete

function.name: wiki_save
function.description: Save notes, articles, or research findings into the agnostic LLM Wiki vault with automatic frontmatter and vector embedding.

title.description: Title of the note (slugified to filename)

content.description: Markdown text with key takeaways, sections, and references

function.name: wiki_search
function.description: Semantic vector search across all notes in the LLM Wiki vault using cosine similarity.

function.name: feed
function.description: Broad-interest source-order feed with screenshots; no preference scoring or filtering by default. Collected preferences are data only. Events are optional via personal_discover.

account.description: Instagram account name, letters, digits, dot, underscore, max 30 (instagram only)

source.description: instagram: "home" (default). rss: an RSSHub route like /youtube/channel/UC... or an http(s) feed URL (required for rss)

filter.description: Score posts with Jev; return only those worth a look, with screenshots

include_filtered.description: With filter: also return posts that did not pass

exploration.description: Chance a below-threshold post passes anyway

function.name: feed_decide
function.description: Record your judgement of a feed post. Needs the owner bearer token. Stored with the feed run and the prediction shown; these are your guesses, not the owner's taste. Reuse idempotency_key to retry safely.

function.name: personal_discover
function.description: Ranked Melbourne events for the next N days from Humanitix and Eventbrite (gigs, film screenings, writing competitions, writing groups, book swaps/clubs, volunteering), scored by Jev against the owner's preferences. An events supplement, not full discovery: pair with feed for broad-interest posts. Needs the owner bearer token. Returns numbered items with link, date (null when not stated), venue, price, reason, uncertainty, delivery_id and failed_sources. After messaging the owner call personal_feedback type 'shown'. Never books anything.

intent.description: Optional focus; replaces the default categories

topic.description: Extra topic searched first, e.g. jazz

function.name: personal_feedback
function.description: Record the owner's reaction to a discovery item. Needs the owner bearer token. Owner feedback is the truth label (like/save/want_to_go positive, dislike negative); not_now, too_far, too_expensive and this_time scope are not lasting dislikes. type 'shown' with delivery_id(s) records that you delivered the items. Reuse idempotency_key to retry safely.

url.description: Alternative to item_id: the link of the post or event the owner means

function.name: personal_recent
function.description: What the owner was actually shown recently, in message order. Needs the owner bearer token. Use when the owner replies in a new conversation and you lack ids: discovery_runs[].items[] has number, title, url, delivery_id, item_id (only deliveries acknowledged with personal_feedback type 'shown'); sent_posts[] has feed posts you decided send_to_owner. Then call personal_feedback with the ids or url.

function.name: personal_preferences
function.description: Read the owner's preference summary and explicit rules, rebuild it, or set/remove a rule. Needs the owner bearer token.
